'''Bammer''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he served alongside [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] when they were tasked to destroy a Separatist ship during the [[Battle of Lanteeb]]. However, the Separatist ship was hijacked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] which gave him enough time to escape and fly to safety. After a short pursuit, Bammer was hit unexpectedly by a volley of lasers that destroyed his starfighter, which killed him.
